reason: Spec E-20260928-15 tests whether typing items at bind time (a retriever plus a typed Choice per source field, confirmed once) is as accurate as the serve-time G7 Choice per item and cheaper at serve time, and whether a schema change silently mistypes items; no register belief covers it, so it decides G7's design rather than a grade. It is recommended now because it is the one gateway change the survey synthesis proposes, and the spec adds the field-level clustering the card missed (items from one field share one mapping, so at least 120 distinct fields are required).
